items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Stock Looks Reasonable On A 166% Five Year Run
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase stock has delivered a strong 166.0% total return over the past 5 years, and the latest intrinsic value work using the Excess Returns model now points to the shares trading at a discount, while traditional valuation checks paint a more mixed picture. That split leaves investors weighing a stock with solid long term performance against signals that are not fully one sided on value. Over 5 years, a 166.0% total return suggests JPMorgan Chase has already created substantial value...
